contractEnforcements.flowScope: 9 logic-level end-to-end flow tests that compose the production R3.0B+C+D+E+F module surfaces over MemoryBackend with deterministic stamps. NO browser DOM, NO jsdom, NO external network, NO runtime LLM. Production code is unchanged in F2 except a defensive JSON-stringify semantic alignment in r3-0f-migration-engine.js that allows undefined property values (mirroring JSON.stringify omit-on-undefined rule) so that R3.0B case-store's importBundle output — which sets `schema: undefined` — survives the F1 sanitize+serialize pipeline. The post-clone JSON-safety walker and trap-free serializer continue to reject BigInt / Date / Map / Set / typed arrays / Symbol / function / NaN / Infinity / non-plain-prototype values and never invoke prototype toJSON hooks.
contractEnforcements.deterministic: Every flow injects a fixed stamp into createFlowHarness. The F1 engine + R3.0B stores + R3.0E stores accept the stamp and use it for all generated timestamps. Same flow inputs always produce identical outputs.
contractEnforcements.noNetworkNoLLM: Tests load only local modules. No HTTP/WS/network IO. No runtime LLM. The VRE flow (Flow 05) explicitly asserts runtimeLLMDecisionAuthority is disabled.
contractEnforcements.consoleErrorGuard: createFlowHarness installs a console.error shim + unhandledRejection handler; each flow asserts the post-flow consoleErrorCount === 0. Any silent failure surfaces.
contractEnforcements.forbiddenActionsGate: createFlowHarness exposes assertForbiddenActionsDisabled which throws on autoReferenceLap / autoApplySetup / runtimeLLMDecisionAuthority / causationClaim / driverBlame. Each flow that touches the corresponding scope calls the gate.
contractEnforcements.noStaleUiContract: createFlowHarness exposes assertNoStaleCaseRef which throws when a viewmodel-like object retains a sourceCaseId that does not match the activeCaseId. Tests that perform case-transition scenarios call this gate before asserting post-state.
contractEnforcements.scopePinReassertion: Flow 04 (reference lap) and Flow 07 (driver experiment) cross-check governance/r3.0/train.json scopePinMirror values at runtime: sameAnalysisCaseOnly=true, sameSessionOnly=true, crossSessionForbidden=true, deltaSign='comparison-reference', explicitUserSelectionOnly=true, fastestValidEnabled=false, medianValidEnabled=false, bestSectorCompositeEnabled=false.
contractEnforcements.appendOnlyTimelineCovered: Flow 06 appends a second event with createdAt strictly greater than the first; verifies the prior event is preserved unchanged; verifies an out-of-order createdAt is rejected by the R3.0E timeline-store.
contractEnforcements.credibilityClosedEnum: Flow 03 asserts credibility rung is exactly one of {measured, derived, heuristic, synthetic}; never upgraded; qualifiers stay in limitations[].
contractEnforcements.exportImportContract: Flow 08 asserts the portable bundle has NO raw telemetry array; importBundle creates an imported_summary record that can never be duplicated to local_full; F1 migration treats the imported record as at-target (no migration).
contractEnforcements.electronSmokeContract: Flow 09 verifies electron CLI installed, --version handshake works, main.js declares contextIsolation:true + nodeIntegration:false, and preload.js exposes only contextBridge (no ipcRenderer leak, no fs/child_process/net/http requires).
contractEnforcements.stateFloors: F2 enables e2e_automation_present. uiAllowed and featureRegistryActivationAllowed remain false. runtimeConsumersAllowed and algorithmsAllowed unchanged from F1. R3.0B case-record schema NOT modified.
